algorithm_scope.reason: This protocol governs the PPO pillar of the LetterEnv benchmark only. DQN is a separate, self-contained pillar (see benchmarks/letter_env/DQN_PROTOCOL.md) with its own frozen plan and gate; the two are not mixed here.

formula_corpus.selection_rule: all official DeepLTL LetterEnv-v0 evaluation formulas -- the same frozen 50-formula corpus used by the letter_env DQN pillar (evidence/letter_env/validation/letter_env_corpus_freeze.json)

interpretation_guardrails.primary_interpretation: P_sat says whether the formula was satisfied; semantic provenance explains what kind of satisfaction or failure occurred.
interpretation_guardrails.cross_algorithm_comparison_caveat: This PPO pillar and the DQN pillar share the same environment, curriculum object, and formula corpus, but are not claimed to be trained to equivalent absolute competence -- see benchmarks/letter_env/DQN_PROTOCOL.md and PPO_PROTOCOL.md for each pillar's own curriculum-stage history. Cross-algorithm findings should be reported per-pillar with that context, not collapsed into a single number.

training.gpu_assignment: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 for every seed -- this project dedicates GPU0 to the letter_env DQN pillar and GPU1 to this PPO pillar, unlike deepltl_point's confirmatory campaign which cycled across both GPUs. Seeds run sequentially (max_concurrent=1) on GPU1, not concurrently, to avoid the GPU-contention throughput collapse already observed and documented once this session (see DQN_PROTOCOL.md's stall investigation) -- five PPO processes sharing one GPU concurrently would very plausibly reproduce the same failure mode deliberately rather than by accident.
training.target_steps_note: DeepLTL's own run_letter.py default is 15,000,000 steps. 5,000,000 is a deliberate, documented reduced budget, the same deviation already made for the same reason by deepltl_point's own PPO campaign, and matched here to the letter_env DQN pillar's budget for comparability.
